purpose: The exact, named set of REQUIRED acceptance entries that are NOT satisfied on the document a reader reaches at the record's own intended_winner_page. validate:agent-artifact-absorption-trigger fails on any outstanding id absent from this list, and fails again when an id here becomes satisfied without being removed. It only ever shrinks.
acceptance_predicate_note: Measured with the tightened predicate in scripts/lib/bhpc_agent_acceptance_satisfaction.mjs: every assertion is made against readerRenderedMarkup(), so a record id or a required string sitting in an HTML comment, a JSON provenance payload or a hidden element no longer counts as rendered. The previous 869/946 was measured with a bare html.includes() over the raw file; re-measured honestly against the tightened predicate that same tree was 822/946, because 47 records were carried entirely by the append-only comment ledger and hidden evidence spans. 822 is the real baseline this file shrank from.

defect_classes.unpublishable_required_string: The record's query column transcribes a repository FILENAME rather than a question a reader would type - 'what is README - Spry Executive OS', derived from the name of insights/README.html, whose published title is 'How to Use the Spry Executive OS Insights Library'. scripts/lib/bhpc_agent_reader_questions.mjs declines to print it, for the same reason the applier already refuses to publish operator-facing text as reader copy (see its recommendation_summary and definition_callout branches, which shipped internal critique to 28 and 42 live pages before they were stopped). The requirement is deliberately NOT dropped from required_strings: deleting a requirement is not satisfying it. These four stay REQUIRED, stay outstanding, and stay named here. They clear when the artifact rows are re-issued with a real query, or when the page is re-slugged away from README.

twin_page_decision.subject: The six root-level pages that carried run 2026-07-18's work before the routing fix moved it to the /insights/ pages the records cite.
reasoning: All six were created on 2026-07-18, the run date of the defective routing, while every /insights/ counterpart dates from March 2026. They are products of the defect, not editorial pages that predate it.

They are NOT six duplicates. Only two (a-realistic-morning-routine..., a-simple-knowledge-system...) share a topic with the /insights/ page of the same slug. The other four carry a different H1 and a different subject and merely collide on the slug at a different path - e.g. a-simple-system-for-tracking-what-actually-matters.html is titled 'How to create a weekly debrief prompt in ChatGPT for goal tracking'. Retiring them as duplicates would be retiring four pages that are not duplicates.

Coverage does not need it. With all six left in place the reader-document figure is 942/946. Removing a live page here would be removing a page to tidy a report, which is the one thing this audit must not do.

Retiring a route in this repository is a formal tree-wide migration - data/content/manual_redirects.json plus an exact _redirects line plus ZERO references anywhere in the tree, enforced by validate:retired-route-references. These six are referenced by data/routes/public_route_manifest.json, data/authority/internal_authority_scores.json, data/citation/citable_pages.json, answers.json, llms.txt, sitemap-spry.xml and several guide pages. That is a content migration plus a full rebuild, not a validation fix, and bundling it here would hold a proven fix behind an unproven one.

Cross-canonicalising the two genuine duplicates was considered and rejected: scripts/repair/repair_dual_domain_metadata.js rewrites canonical tags on every build, so a hand-set cross-canonical would not survive the next release and would read as fixed while being reverted.

The recurrence is closed at the cause, not by cleanup. scripts/agent_intake/bhpc_agent_common.mjs now resolves intended_winner_path from the intended winner URL in preference to a hand-typed repo_file_path, so no future record can create a seventh twin; and assertion E of validate:agent-artifact-absorption-trigger reconciles at the reader's document, so if one ever were created the record would read outstanding at the cited URL and fail as a new gap.
